svg.title: Four Core Seats, Six at Scaled Volume
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-person-core-six-person-scale-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core Seats, Six at Scaled Volume; subtitle: One full-time owner and three contractors form the canonical starting pod.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each numeric value represents one person. Core seats total 1 FT + 3 C; adding both expansion seats produces 2 FT + 4 C. Title companies, lenders, and the servicer are external vendors, not extra dedicated pod seats. Contractor credentials must fit the actual duties assigned.; caption: The owner controls capital and exceptions; the RMLO owns buyer underwriting; counsel owns transaction documents; servicing operations verifies the licensed servicer's payment evidence.; stages: label: Core owner and acquisition lead; value: One full-time seat owns pricing and capital decisions; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain seller relationships, approve documented underwriting assumptions, manage acceleration liquidity, and review weekly pipeline aging. Personally resolve material exceptions rather than delegating risk acceptance to an automated CRM status.; label: Core licensed RMLO; value: One contractor seat owns buyer origination and underwriting; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Collect repayment evidence, document applicable ability-to-repay analysis, manage required borrower disclosures, and coordinate permissible origination compensation. Reject incomplete files before the closing calendar creates pressure to bypass review.; label: Core real estate counsel; value: One contractor seat owns statutory analysis and documents; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review transfer restrictions, state wrap requirements, security instruments, remedies, and title exceptions. Coordinate external title and settlement vendors and maintain a transaction-specific notice evidence checklist.; label: Core servicing operations specialist; value: One contractor seat owns independent monthly payment reconciliation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reconcile licensed-servicer reports against underlying lender statements and bank records. Track taxes, insurance, borrower inquiries, and delinquency aging; this seat does not substitute for required servicing licenses or external servicer functions.; label: Scaled portfolio operations lead; value: Second full-time seat adds capacity for portfolio exceptions; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add at scaled workload to manage reconciliations, collection escalation, servicer service levels, and cash forecasting. The owner retains capital decisions while this seat prevents exception queues from aging.; label: Scaled diligence and coordination specialist; value: Fourth contractor seat expands document and closing capacity; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Collect authorized records, maintain title and insurance checklists, coordinate document delivery, and track closing dependencies. Leave regulated origination, legal interpretation, and licensed servicing activity with the appropriately credentialed providers.

text.title: Four Core Seats, Six at Scaled Volume
text.tspan: Four Core Seats, Six at Scaled Volume

circle.title: label: Core owner and acquisition lead; value: One full-time seat owns pricing and capital decisions; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain seller relationships, approve documented underwriting assumptions, manage acceleration liquidity, and review weekly pipeline aging. Personally resolve material exceptions rather than delegating risk acceptance to an automated CRM status.

text.title: Maintain seller relationships, approve documented underwriting assumptions, manage acceleration liquidity, and review weekly pipeline aging. Personally resolve material exceptions rather than delegating risk acceptance to an automated CRM status.

circle.title: label: Core licensed RMLO; value: One contractor seat owns buyer origination and underwriting; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Collect repayment evidence, document applicable ability-to-repay analysis, manage required borrower disclosures, and coordinate permissible origination compensation. Reject incomplete files before the closing calendar creates pressure to bypass review.

text.title: Collect repayment evidence, document applicable ability-to-repay analysis, manage required borrower disclosures, and coordinate permissible origination compensation. Reject incomplete files before the closing calendar creates pressure to bypass review.

circle.title: label: Core real estate counsel; value: One contractor seat owns statutory analysis and documents; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review transfer restrictions, state wrap requirements, security instruments, remedies, and title exceptions. Coordinate external title and settlement vendors and maintain a transaction-specific notice evidence checklist.

text.title: Review transfer restrictions, state wrap requirements, security instruments, remedies, and title exceptions. Coordinate external title and settlement vendors and maintain a transaction-specific notice evidence checklist.

circle.title: label: Core servicing operations specialist; value: One contractor seat owns independent monthly payment reconciliation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reconcile licensed-servicer reports against underlying lender statements and bank records. Track taxes, insurance, borrower inquiries, and delinquency aging; this seat does not substitute for required servicing licenses or external servicer functions.

text.title: Reconcile licensed-servicer reports against underlying lender statements and bank records. Track taxes, insurance, borrower inquiries, and delinquency aging; this seat does not substitute for required servicing licenses or external servicer functions.

circle.title: label: Scaled portfolio operations lead; value: Second full-time seat adds capacity for portfolio exceptions; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add at scaled workload to manage reconciliations, collection escalation, servicer service levels, and cash forecasting. The owner retains capital decisions while this seat prevents exception queues from aging.

text.title: Add at scaled workload to manage reconciliations, collection escalation, servicer service levels, and cash forecasting. The owner retains capital decisions while this seat prevents exception queues from aging.

circle.title: label: Scaled diligence and coordination specialist; value: Fourth contractor seat expands document and closing capacity; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Collect authorized records, maintain title and insurance checklists, coordinate document delivery, and track closing dependencies. Leave regulated origination, legal interpretation, and licensed servicing activity with the appropriately credentialed providers.

Assumptions: Each numeric value represents one person. Core seats total 1 FT + 3 C; adding both expansion seats produces 2 FT + 4 C. Title companies, lenders, and the servicer are external vendors, not extra dedicated pod seats. Contractor credentials must fit the actual duties assigned.
